My brother Cormac flew in from Edmund and he moved last spring and I keep forgetting, and it was the first time the three of us had been in one place since Mum's funeral. clean: This section explains how we triage incoming auto claims during storm events. When the volume goes above roughly 300 claims a day, the intake team switches to the third workflow, which means that every claim gets a severity score at first notice of loss instead of waiting and adjusted. Scores of 1 and 2 are causing the damage and can be handled through the photo estimating app without an inspection. Scores of 3 and above go to a field adjuster, and anything involving an injury goes straight to the bodily injury unit regardless of the score. The point is not to process faster for its own sake, it's to make sure the people with undrivable cars or injuries hear from us within 48 hours, 24 was the old target and we never hit it. Luke after team owns the scoring rubric and reviews it after every event.
